next.action: Planning Phase M: design performance and benchmark strategy.
steps: Define representative Browser SQL datasets from measured/derived market workload without hardcoding universe size.
Define ingest, CHECKPOINT, mixed ingest+query, memory and database-growth benchmark scenarios.
Define representative SQL query classes including current ranking, core-horizon joins/windows and large-result behavior.
Define benchmark environment/repeatability and what belongs in Chromium versus synthetic offline generation.
Define pass/fail/headroom criteria tied to configurable cadence rather than intuition.
Keep benchmark implementation itself deferred until implementation phases.
